title: Be like the shepherds!
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
It is Christmas!
In today’s lesson we are looking at what the 
SHEPHERDS did
on the very first Christmas….

The angel 
tells the shepherds 
how they will find Jesus, 
in the manger

BE LIKE THE SHEPHERDS
After they found baby Jesus in a manger
They could NOT keep quiet
They told EVERYBODY about what happened
They were so excited!

We must also tell people about Jesus
Tell your friends, tell your gogo, tell your family

You will need:
empty toilet rolls
Glue
Scissors
A marker
Any paper, stickers, material, tinfoil, cotton wool
and your imagination

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord
Thank you for baby Jesus
Thank you for loving me so much
that You sent your son to earth
Amen
